title: Count in tens and hundreds
description: Count in tens and hundreds within 1000.

title: Use notation, representations and place value to 1000
description: Interpret hundreds, tens and ones in numbers up to 1000 using notation and representations.

title: Read and write numbers to 1000
description: Read and write numbers up to 1000 in numerals and words.

title: Compare and order numbers to 1000
description: Compare and order numbers within 1000.

title: Recognise number-sequence patterns
description: Describe and continue patterns in number sequences.

title: Identify odd and even numbers
description: Classify whole numbers as odd or even.

title: Add and subtract up to three digits
description: Use addition and subtraction algorithms with numbers up to three digits.

title: Solve addition and subtraction word problems
description: Solve up to two-step word problems involving addition and subtraction.
readinessEvidence: Solves one-step addition and subtraction situations and identifies known and unknown quantities.
masteryEvidence: Selects a part-whole or comparison structure independently.
Labels known and unknown quantities correctly before calculating.
Solves a two-step addition/subtraction word problem and explains what each bar segment represents.

title: Mentally add and subtract place-value units
description: Mentally add or subtract ones, tens or hundreds to or from a three-digit number.

title: Use multiplication tables of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10
description: Build and recall multiplication facts for 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10.
readinessEvidence: Forms equal groups with objects and skip-counts repeated equal groups.
masteryEvidence: Represents a multiplication fact with equal groups or an array.
Recalls facts for 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10 independently across mixed practice.
Explains what the two factors represent in an equal-groups context.

title: Use the division symbol
description: Use ÷ to represent division situations.
readinessEvidence: Shares a collection equally and forms equal-sized groups with concrete objects.
masteryEvidence: Writes a division equation for an equal-sharing situation.
Writes a division equation for a grouping situation.
Explains the contextual meaning of dividend, group size or number of groups without interchanging them.

title: Relate multiplication and division
description: Recognise multiplication and division as related inverse operations.
readinessEvidence: Represents the same equal-groups situation using multiplication and division equations when prompted.
masteryEvidence: Generates the related multiplication and division facts from one known fact.
Uses a known multiplication fact to determine a related division fact and explains why it works.

title: Multiply and divide within known tables
description: Multiply and divide within the multiplication tables of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10.
readinessEvidence: Recalls most multiplication facts for 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10 and can build unknown facts from a representation.
masteryEvidence: Multiplies and divides accurately within the learned tables in mixed practice.
Uses the inverse operation to check a division result.
Distinguishes an isolated fact-retrieval slip from a misunderstanding of the operation.

title: Solve multiplication and division word problems
description: Solve one-step word problems involving multiplication and division within the learned tables.

sourceRefs.locator: P2 multiplication/division and bar-model teaching annotation

readinessEvidence: Identifies equal groups, group size and total in a one-step context.
masteryEvidence: Chooses multiplication or division from the relationship in the story rather than from keywords.
Represents the quantities with equal groups or a suitable bar model.
Solves both sharing and grouping division contexts and explains what the answer represents.

title: Mentally multiply and divide known facts
description: Mentally multiply and divide within the tables of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10.
readinessEvidence: Solves learned multiplication and division facts accurately with a representation available.
masteryEvidence: Retrieves mixed multiplication and division facts mentally with consistent accuracy.
Self-corrects occasional recall slips without changing the operation structure.

title: Interpret a fraction as part of a whole
description: Interpret a fraction as equal parts of one whole.

title: Use fraction notation and representations
description: Read, write and represent fractions using numerator and denominator notation and visual forms.

title: Compare and order unit and like fractions
description: Compare and order unit fractions and like fractions with given denominators not exceeding 12.

title: Add and subtract like fractions
description: Add and subtract like fractions within one whole with given denominators not exceeding 12.

title: Count money in dollars and cents
description: Count an amount of money expressed in dollars and cents.

title: Read and write money in decimal notation
description: Read and write amounts of money using decimal notation.

title: Compare money amounts
description: Compare two or three amounts of money.

title: Convert between decimal money and cents
description: Convert an amount in decimal notation to cents only and vice versa.

title: Measure length, mass and liquid volume
description: Measure length in metres, mass in kilograms or grams, and liquid volume in litres.

title: Choose appropriate measurement units
description: Use appropriate units and abbreviations m, g, kg and ℓ for the quantity measured.

title: Compare and order measurements
description: Compare and order lengths, masses and liquid volumes.

title: Tell time to the minute
description: Tell time to the nearest minute.

title: Measure time in hours and minutes
description: Measure elapsed time in hours and minutes.

title: Convert hours and minutes
description: Convert a time in hours and minutes to minutes only and vice versa.

title: Make and complete patterns with 2-D shapes
description: Make or complete patterns using one or two attributes among size, shape, colour and orientation.

title: Identify, name, describe and classify 3-D shapes
description: Identify, name, describe and classify cubes, cuboids, cones, cylinders and spheres.

title: Read and interpret scaled picture graphs
description: Read and interpret data presented in picture graphs with scales.

sourceRefs.locator: P2 / Statistics / Picture Graphs with Scales / 1.1
